why: Every Ruche package in this project must run from a tracked-only clean checkout with no dependency on any sibling task directory. instrumented.py originates in an UNTRACKED research-task directory (TASK-2026-08-30-SMCSTAT/analysis) which exists in the developer working tree and in no git clone; the first ARM 1 Ruche job of TASK-2026-09-01-SMCRUCHE-PACKFIX died with ModuleNotFoundError for exactly that reason. Here the bundle carries a second obligation: this task's populations at zeta in {0.10, 0.20, 0.70} are compared rung-to-rung against each other and read alongside a zeta=0.35 reference row produced by this same file. Identical bytes are what licenses treating the N_c ladder as one measurement rather than five.
closure_method: Not recomputed. Established by sha256 identity with TASK-2026-09-05-NC-ZETA-CALIBRATION/support/instrumented.py, which inherited it from TASK-2026-09-03-MOCK-LOWLAMBDA-EXTENSION, TASK-2026-09-02-MOCK-PRODUCTION and ultimately TASK-2026-09-01-SMCRUCHE-PACKFIX, where the import closure was computed by ast.parse of instrumented.py, walking Import/ImportFrom nodes and following any resolving to a sibling module in the untracked SMCSTAT analysis directory. Result: no sibling imports at all. Identical bytes have identical import closure.

files.note: Copied verbatim with cp(1) and verified with cmp(1). NOT rewritten, NOT reformatted, NOT re-implemented. This is the exact file that produced every zeta=0.35 production population in this programme, validated bitwise against production by TASK-2026-08-30-SMCSTAT.

runners_verbatim_not_integrity_scanned.note: The certified per-row executor, unmodified. This task adds no argument, changes no default and touches no sampler parameter.

The packing wrapper. NO LONGER byte-identical to the predecessor's: this task repaired a packaging fault in it on 2026-09-08. It previously invoked shared/run_cell.py while chdir'ed into an arm; run_cell.py reads manifest.csv from the directory its own file sits in, so every row looked for shared/manifest.csv and died with FileNotFoundError before the sampler was reached (Ruche job IDs 1694328-1694621, zero result JSONs -- see ../RUCHE_INCIDENT_2026-09-08.md). It now invokes ARM/run_cell.py and verifies at job start that those bytes equal shared/run_cell.py. The change is packaging only: it alters WHICH FILE is executed, not what that file does. run_cell.py itself is untouched and still sha256 571f7ff42baccf2905f04fed2ade24f13fd1316edb47ac9cb8d7491e75a1f0a8.

integrity_scan_note: run_cell.py's startup integrity check iterates files[] and resolves each entry against support/ by basename. Only entries that live in support/ may appear there; the two runner scripts live in shared/ and are recorded under runners_verbatim_not_integrity_scanned instead. Their hashes are checked by tools/negative_controls.py N3 rather than at job start, because a runner that had been altered would have altered the check itself.

arm_local_executor.why: run_cell.py resolves manifest.csv and its default results/ directory from its own __file__, never from the working directory and never from an argument. An executor shipped only in shared/ therefore runs the wrong (non-existent) manifest for every arm. Each arm now carries a byte-identical copy, written verbatim by tools/build_arms.py.

support_copies.why: run_cell.py resolves its bundle as HERE/../support. An arm one level deeper than the rest -- conditional/M_z070_nc2048 -- would resolve that to a directory that does not exist and would fail its startup integrity gate. That parent therefore carries a byte-identical copy of support/, written by tools/build_arms.py. Identical bytes, so the integrity check inside run_cell.py is the same check against the same file.
